54/S0.subgoal: Explain the objectives of optimizing VR resources by balancing hardware requirements and user experience.

54/S1.subgoal: Describe the different types of resources available in the context of extended reality and virtual reality.

54/S2.subgoal: Explain why the focus of VR resource optimization is on hardware resources at the client end.

54/S3.subgoal: Describe why understanding computer graphics is a prerequisite for understanding VR hardware requirements.

54/S4.subgoal: Explain the fundamental concepts of computer graphics, including images, objects, and the roles of representation and synthesis.

54/S5.subgoal: Describe the architecture of a generic graphics system, including the display controller, video memory, and video controller.

54/S6.subgoal: Compare vector scan and raster scan rendering methods and explain the necessity of screen refreshing.

54/S7.subgoal: Explain how color is represented and perceived on a digital display.
